_doc: Market Desk source registry. 'public' controls whether items may appear on the public Market Desk page. 'internal' sources feed only the private desk brief. Every source is fetched as RSS only; article pages are never requested.
user_agent: PillarMarketDesk/1.0 (+https://melaniegrahamprock.com/market-desk; feed reader; contact: site owner)

mfdive.name: Multifamily Dive
mfdive.terms: Industry Dive. Headline, link and our own one-line note only. Confirm syndication terms before launch.

bisnow_national.name: Bisnow
bisnow_national.terms: Headline, link and our own note only. Confirm terms before launch.

bisnow_phoenix.name: Bisnow Phoenix
bisnow_phoenix.terms: Low frequency (a few stories a month). Treat as healthy unless silent 30 days.

yardi_blog.name: Yardi Matrix
yardi_blog.terms: Primary research. Report PDFs are not downloaded or summarized beyond the headline.

nareit.name: Nareit
nareit.terms: Use /news/rss.xml. The site-root /rss.xml is stale (newest item 2018) and is excluded.

wsj_realestate.name: The Wall Street Journal
wsj_realestate.terms: Dow Jones terms limit RSS content to personal, non-commercial use without written consent. Internal brief only until licensed.

globest_multifamily.name: GlobeSt
globest_multifamily.terms: Endpoint answers but returns zero items (checked Nov 14, 2026). Held out until the feed carries stories again.

urbanist.name: The Urbanist
urbanist.terms: Seattle housing, land use and policy news (nonprofit, advocacy leaning). robots.txt allows the feed (checked Nov 14, 2026). Only housing headlines pass the relevance gate. Headline, link and our own note only. Confirm terms before launch.

no_feed.NMHC: No RSS endpoint found. Research releases checked by hand weekly and linked from Market Signal when used.
no_feed.RealPage Analytics: Not reachable from the fetcher in testing. Checked by hand.
no_feed.U.S. Census Bureau, BLS, FRED: Data series, not news. They drive Market Pulse through the FRED data service, not this feed.
no_feed.The Seattle Times: Real estate feed returns an empty response to our automated reader (Nov 14, 2026). Respected, not worked around. Checked by hand.
no_feed.Multi-Housing News: Feed answers 403 Forbidden to our automated reader on every refresh (Nov 9-16, 2026). Respected, not worked around. Checked by hand.
